entries.en: It appears business at the Turali Travel Agency is booming, as Zelihali so enthusiastically informs you. After chatting about recent happenings in your lives, the Hanu remembers that Wawkesa wanted to speak with you about something─likely a new venture that he and Liplu are planning. She soon takes her leave to attend to new arrivals, leaving you to make for the eatery and find out what the pair has in store for you.
entries.fr: Zelihali vous a appris que Liplu et Wawkesa avaient quelque chose d'important à vous dire. Allez parler à ce dernier à l'embarcadère de Poga, à Kozama'uka.
entries.ja: ゼリハリから、ワーケサが冒険者に会いたがっているという話を聞いた。コザマル・カのポガ停船所で「ワーケサ」と話そう。

entries.en: Liplu and Wawkesa ask whether you are behind the recent stories told by their customers across Tural of a lone traveler with skilled hands and a selfless heart. After admitting your role in helping both Zirgorteh the Open-armed and Gok Golma flourish, Liplu declares you the perfect  to deliver a missive to the people in charge of each endeavor. Apparently she is planning some sort of “joint venture,” and while neither she nor Wawkesa are forthcoming with details, they waste no time in sending you on your way, suggesting you stop first at Zirgorteh the Open-armed.

entries.en: Your old friend Fahrafahr happily accepts the letter from the Turali Travel Agency, although something about her demeanor becomes decidedly coy after she begins reading it. She does not say why, but encourages you to visit with the snow spirits in Zirgorteh the Open-armed while she finishes reading the letter with Vuyargur. You traverse the passage up the mountains, where snow and playful creatures await.
entries.fr: Fahrafahr a besoin d'étudier le contenu de la lettre en compagnie de Vuyargur. Pendant ce temps, allez rendre visite à Ryoqor Terteh.
entries.ja: ファーラファーに手紙を渡した。何やら込み入ったことが書かれていたらしく、彼女は、仲間とともに読み切るまでの間、リョコー・テーテと会っていってほしいようだ。ジィゴーテー拝壇の「リョコー・テーテ」と話そう。

entries.en: You arrive in the snowy valley to see Nopli and Murfurlur standing before Ryoqor Terteh, who eagerly invites you to play. Before frolicking in the snow, however, you ponder the contents of Liplu's letter with those present. Is it a business proposal? Something else entirely? None can say for sure, and after Ryoqor Terteh becomes impatient with the conversation, you indulge the spirits in their snowy games. After an exhausting few bouts, Nopli suggests that you return to Shelter, that you might finally learn your purpose for coming to Urqopacha.
entries.fr: Vous avez passé du bon temps avec Ryoqor Terteh et ses amis. Parlez à Fahrafahr.
entries.ja: リョコー・テーテと話した。生前墓ができてから、彼らはほかのヨカフイ族とも仲良くやっていたらしい。雪守の塚屋の「ファーラファー」と話そう。

entries.en: While it seems Fahrafahr has indeed read the letter in its entirety, she shares no new information other than that she would love to be a part of Liplu's plan. The nature of this plan yet remains elusive, but your first task is done. Now, you must deliver the second letter. You say good-bye to the towering peaks of Urqopacha and set forth to the thick canopies of Yak T'el.
entries.fr: Fahrafahr est prête à se plier en quatre pour faire aboutir le projet des dirigeants de Tural Voyages. À présent, allez remettre la seconde lettre à Ruvoll Ja, à Gok Golma.

entries.en: Ruvoll Ja catches you up on recent developments within Gok Golma before you hand him the letter from Liplu. In a somewhat familiar turn of events, the Mamool Ja asks you to wait while he shares the contents of the letter with Anggir, and suggests you head to the kitchen and meet some familiar faces. There, you see Ty'at Roh, Bol Tst'ei, and Gotoll Ja deep in conversation about a new dish of Bol Tst'ei's creation. Your arrival sparks a discussion about food's role in the future of Mamook, and after sampling the dish, you regale the trio with stories of the myriad meals you have partaken in during your travels. After some time, Ruvoll Ja and Anggir finally join you, and it seems both are eager to help Liplu. Although you still know little about what her “plan” entails aside from the fact it may take place in Urqopacha, your duty is done, and you make the long trek back to Yak T'el to report to Liplu.
entries.fr: Ruvoll Ja, Anggir, Gotoll Ja, ainsi que Bol Tst'ei et Ty'at Roh sont aux anges après avoir pris connaissance du projet commun. Retournez transmettre les réponses de vos camarades à Liplu, à l'embarcadère de Poga.

Preparations for what, exactly, is as of yet a mystery to you, but it is plain that your participation is expected─and perhaps mandatory.

entries.en: Well, I heard a few former Mamook residents were returning from Tuliyollal. I sensed an opportunity to use my cooking to show them how much their old home has changed, and the culinary wheels began to turn.
entries.fr: Ruvoll Ja m'a appris que ses proches allaient revenir à Mamook pour la première fois depuis longtemps. Je me suis donc dit que ce serait une bonne occasion pour eux de faire l'expérience du renouveau de la cité grâce à ma cuisine, en plus de tout le reste.

entries.en: Ruvoll Ja and the others poured their sweat and tears into the gainery, and our relations with the Xbr'aal have at last started to improve. Ty'at Roh and the other hunters can visit without fear of menacing stares or harsh words.
entries.fr: Grâce au dur labeur de Ruvoll Ja et de ses compagnons, Gok Golma a prospéré comme jamais. L'animosité entre les Xbr'aal et les Mamool Ja est déjà quasiment de l'histoire ancienne, au point que Ty'at Roh et ses amis peuvent désormais venir nous rendre visite sans la moindre hésitation.

entries.en: Mamook has changed. The entirety of Yak T'el has changed. For the better, of course...but not everyone knows this, and it's our job to spread the good tidings.
entries.fr: Mamook ainsi que toute la forêt de Yak T'el ont beaucoup changé en un temps record, et surtout en bien. Nous en sommes tellement fiers que nous aimerions le faire savoir au monde entier, ja !

entries.en: Mamook has had a reputation as an inhospitable place for so long that many treat it as fact. Even I refused to believe it had changed until I saw it with my own eyes.
entries.fr: Difficile d'en vouloir aux sceptiques doutant encore que cette cité aurait pu évoluer à ce point en si peu de temps... J'avais moi-même du mal à le croire avant de le voir de mes propres yeux.

……ワシも、実際にこの目で見るまで信じられなかったからな。
